content.overview: Kimone Napier is a powerhouse in HR strategy, bringing deep expertise in operations and systems engineering. Together, we reimagined her brand as Hire Breakthrough—a bold shift into the B2B space. Her mission? To help big businesses tackle big challenges like the Great Resignation, with strategic HR that actually works.
content.challenge: We led the transition from a personal brand to a business-forward identity, with full creative freedom to shape the visual direction from scratch. The challenge? Craft a brand that speaks the language of large enterprises—confident, modern, and built to inspire trust at scale.
content.solution: The result? A bold, flexible identity that captured the spirit of Hire Breakthrough. Kimone rolled it out seamlessly across all touchpoints—website, socials, and brand assets. Today, Hire Breakthrough stands as a trusted HR partner to clients around the globe.
